text:
alyssa: FYI sales reported a customer saw doubled embedding counts after enabling hedging. They want clarity on billing + console display.

mike: Runtime fans out hedged attempts and our internal metrics count each RPC. Console tries to group by request_id but billing is per RPC today.

sofia: Console should show one logical request with a hedging badge and an expandable list of attempts. Billing view needs an include/exclude toggle.

cheng: Billing options: bill all attempts; bill winner only; or bill winner but charge losers above a GPU_usage threshold.

jordan: For embeds, GPU time matters. If losers spun up models they cost us. Winner-only could lose revenue.

lee: Proposal: default winner-only within same hedge_request_id + same model family; mark losers chargeable if attempt_gpu_ms > 100. Emit chargeable_flag.

ops-bot: Canary flag hedging-accounting-v1 enabled for tests. Telemetry fields to add: hedge_request_id, attempt_index, attempt_status, attempt_gpu_ms, attempt_pool, chargeable_flag, hedge_settled.

mike: API: opt-in header X-Embed-Hedge: mode=latency;max_attempts=2. Response includes hedge_request_id. SDK docs needed.

sofia: UX: keep hedging off by default for new tenants until billing policy is live. Tooltip: hedging may incur extra charges for attempts that used significant compute.

alyssa: Action items: runtime telemetry (cheng/mike), billing rule + refund flow design (jordan), console UX + mock (sofia/lee), SDK docs (mike). I'll loop in finance/legal.

mike: I'll seed a console mock for sales. ops-bot: created GH#4521 hedging-accounting-v1.
